facts.cup-forward: The knight rides a white horse toward the right, holding the cup out in front.
facts.slow-horse: The horse walks slowly, one step at a time, with its head lowered.
facts.winged-helmet: Small wings are attached to the helmet and to the heels.
facts.fish-tunic: The tunic over the armor has a red fish pattern.
facts.river: A stream flows in front, with a rocky hill on the right and trees far off.
facts.blue-sky: The background is a blue sky.

glosses.slow-horse: A pace that comes in no hurry to offer the heart.

reversedGloss.excess: Romance and mood go too far, and words run ahead of action.
reversedGloss.blocked: There is a heart to offer, but he cannot get close.

misdescriptions.wrong: The horse gallops at full speed.
